integrity: The realizability criterion is proved symbolically in both directions. The finite count is an exhaustive enumeration of all 256 candidate spectra, cross-checked by a distinct permutation test and by explicit construction and replay of every accepted finite frame. No sampling or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The exact numerical count is for one propositional variable and modal depth at most 2. The support-closure criterion extends to every finite valuation alphabet, but no general closed counting formula is claimed. The result is semantic and does not settle unrestricted infinitary Hilbert-system completeness.
title: A support-closure classification of one-variable depth-two GL types
